recipes.name: Skinner's Stew inspired by The Simpsons
instructions: Cook each type of rice (brown, red, jasmine, and green jade). - 1 cup Brown Rice - 1 cup Red Rice - 1 cup Jasmine Rice - 1 cup Green Jade Rice
Place all 4 rices in a casserole side by side covered with tin foil in a 200°F oven -- keeping everything warm while we make the stew.
Shell and devein some prawns but do not throw away your prawn shells! We are going to use them for the broth. - Prawns

Add some scallions to a saucepan that has oil preheated over medium high heat. Add our prawn shells and sauté until the shells start to show some color, at which point deglaze the pan with a few glugs of white wine and water. - Scallions - Olive oil - Prawn shells - White wine - 1 ½ cups Water
Let simmer for about 45 minutes, then drain and set aside.

Add minced garlic, minced ginger, minced lemongrass, minced shallot, some trimmed green beans and some chopped shiitake mushrooms to a saucepan preheated with olive oil and sauté until fragrant. Deglaze with some of the broth, and add some lime leaves (or 1 fresh squeezed lime). Also add green curry paste and sauté, letting all the flavors get to know each other. Then add bamboo shoots, some sliced red bell pepper, fish sauce, and shellfish broth. - Minced garlic - Minced ginger - Minced lemongrass - Minced shallot - Trimmed green beans - Lime leaves (or fresh squeezed lime) - 2 tbsp green curry paste - Bamboo shoots - Sliced red pepper - Thai bird's eye chillis (optional) - Fish sauce - Shiitake mushrooms - 2 ½ cups shellfish stock
Let cook for a minute, then add coconut milk along with some Thai basil or regular basil. - 1 can of cocount milk - Thai basil or regular basil
Add in monk fish and prawns, and give a good stir. - Monk fish - Prawns
Add in ground cardamom, cayenne pepper and a pinch of brown sugar. Cover and poach for 5-10 minutes, or until everything is cooked through. - Ground cardamom - Cayenne pepper - pinch of brown sugar
Remove rice from the oven and in a small bowl add one scoop of each rice, followed by your stew.
